d: Dipavli ke pavan avsar par patakha jalane va diyon ke karan hone vali sanbhavit aag durghatnaon se nipatne ke lie patna agnishman vibhag ne apni taiyariyan puri kar li hain. patna ke jila agnishman padadhikari abhishek kumar ne bataya ki kisi bhi aapatkalin sthiti men suchna milte hi 3 se 5 minat ke bhitar ghatnasthal par pahunchne ka lakshy rakha gaya hai.
